title: IBM App Connect Enterprise 13.0.1.0 through 13.0.8.2 could allow a remote attacker to obtain… (CVE-2026-18093)
description: IBM App Connect Enterprise versions 13.0.1.0 through 13.0.8.2 contain a vulnerability due to broken access control that could allow a remote attacker to obtain sensitive information. The vulnerability has a high severity with a CVSS score of 7.5. No public exploits or known active exploitation have been reported. No patch or remediation information is provided in the available data.
